conclusion: At the frozen exposure (48000 sample exposures = 1500 steps x 32 batch, i.e. 0.60 epochs of the 10-day pool but only 0.15 epochs of the 40-day pool), the paired daily all-eight-time RankIC difference (40-day minus 10-day, seed-mean) was +0.012727 against a predeclared floor of 0.011647; per window research_a: +0.035772, research_b: -0.010318. The candidate fails the predeclared gates both_windows_improve, worst_day_guardrail, so the 10-day reference is retained. A pooled gain driven by one window while the other degrades is a replication failure, not an improvement, and it is not evidence that more history is uninformative: the 40-day pool is only partially traversed at this fixed step count, and no steps or seeds were added mid-round.
